messages.subject: Forensic engineering report — CR-TR-12 (WML/2026/EX-0488)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

My report is attached. In short: the interlock was defeated using a spare actuator held loose in the maintenance store; the older tongue-and-slot design does not adequately prevent reasonably foreseeable defeat under BS EN ISO 14119; and trapped-key or RFID-coded interlocking with dual-channel monitoring would have prevented it. The control log confirms continuous bypass from 09:48 on 18 March.

This is a foreseeable failure mode and would have been detectable on a competent inspection. Do call if you would like to discuss.

Faisal Iqbal
